item.title: Biogen/Denali Parkinson's Trial Failure
item.description:
• Summary: Biogen and Denali Therapeutics have discontinued their Parkinson's disease program after a Phase 2 trial of the LRRK2 inhibitor BIIB122 (DNL151) failed to meet its primary endpoint. The study enrolled patients with non-genetic Parkinson's, testing whether LRRK2 inhibition could slow disease progression. Despite promising preclinical data and biomarker evidence of target engagement, the drug did not show a clinical benefit. The companies will cease further development, marking a setback for the LRRK2 approach in sporadic Parkinson's.
  • MoAs: LRRK2 kinase inhibitor
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive, BioSpace, Endpoints News, Fierce Biotech, STAT News
